parameters.query: SELECT v.id AS validation_id, v.patient_id, v.texte, v.sources, v.valide_par, v.valide_le, r.civilite, r.prenom, r.nom, r.chambre, r.etage FROM soins.validations v JOIN soins.residents r ON r.patient_id = v.patient_id WHERE v.id = ANY($1::bigint[]) AND v.action = 'generer_sbar' ORDER BY r.chambre

INSERT INTO soins.transmissions (portee, etage, patient_ids, validation_ids, destinataire, canal, sujet, statut, detail) VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, '')::int, $3::text[], $4::bigint[], $5, 'mailpit', $6, $7, $8::jsonb) RETURNING id
